name: Astrodactyl
bodyType: Pterodactyl-like humanoid with a natural jetpack
abilities: Astro-dynakinesis - generates green internalized stellar energy and shapes it with precision
Energy whips and throwing-star constructs channelled through the holes in his arms
Stellar energy breath / projectiles fired from his mouth
Natural jetpack - very fast flight, plus explosive energy waves that knocked an Incursean fighter out of the sky
Enhanced strength (tore Thep Khufan tendrils, ripped free of Revonnahgander-grade adhesive, swung Techadon robots through a brick wall)
Enhanced durability (survived a fall from several hundred feet)
Enhanced reflexes (dodged lasers), acrobatics and prehensile feet (lifted a Cerebrocrustacean)
weaknesses: Vulnerable to electricity, such as a Cerebrocrustacean's (A Fistful of Brains)
summary: A red pterodactyl-glider alien with a built-in jetpack who whips foes with green star-energy and outflies fighter craft.
traits: Squawks like a parrot when talking or excited
Name was invented first; look and powers came later
Was never intended as a Jetray replacement
'Whoever said the sky's the limit never met Astrodactyl!'
notableFeats: Battled Dr. Psychobos and helped destroy the Amber Ogia supply (While You Were Away)
Blasted an Incursean space fighter out of the air with a jetpack energy wave (The Frogs of War: Part 1)
Held his own against Negative Brainstorm until both reverted (A Fistful of Brains)
Fought Bad Ben's Gravattack and saved No Watch Ben from Eon (And Then There Were None)
Broke himself and Rook out of Collectimus's adhesive trap (Collect This)
Smashed Techadon Robots through a wall with energy whips (Clyde 5)

appearances.designNotes: Red skin, large yellow beak, green eyes, black-and-green shoulder and waist clothing, green wrist and ankle braces, small yellow retractable glider wings attached to a jetpack structure on his back; Omnitrix symbol on left shoulder.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render, wings extended (1152x953, transparent). Wings-retracted view: 'Astrodactyljet.PNG' (201x352). 'Astrodactyl official.png' (1477x1137) is the same pose on a green promo background.

scoring.rationale: Mobility 8 and survivability 8: jetpack flight fast enough to dogfight Incursean fighters, space-capable, and tough enough to walk off a multi-hundred-foot fall. Stellar-energy whips, stars and breath give solid mid-range offense. Not a heavy hitter and electricity drops him.

notes: Species and planet are unknown: a Derrick J. Wyatt joke that he came from Terradino sat on the wiki as fact from 2013 until March 2025, when it was debunked (also by Charlotte McDuffie).
Never locked in the Omnitrix. Gravadactyl (with Gravattack) is a Biomnitrix concept only.
The Vampire Strikes Back use is a cameo (flying back to Anur Transyl). Games (Omniverse 2) and comics (Deep Trouble, Super Secret Crisis War!) not counted.
